summary: Autonomous memory engine for Claude Code. Watches sessions, distills durable typed memories via Haiku, injects the highest-value ones back at session start. Ships an MCP server, a REST API, a Svelte 5 dashboard, and a CLI.
purpose: Give Claude Code persistent cross-session memory without manual note-taking — capture, rank, decay, recall.
audience: Claude Code users who want persistent cross-session memory.

entry_points.role: MCP server — 19 tools exposed over stdio transport
Express REST API server, port 3210; serves built dashboard from dist-frontend/
CLI entry point — index, search, inspect from terminal
Claude Code hook manifest — wires SessionStart (recall) and Stop/PreCompact/SessionEnd (capture)

key_files.role: Reads extraction_models.yaml; provides runtime config with sane defaults
Background capture pipeline — reads new transcript lines, calls Haiku, dedup-merges memories
Haiku-based memory extraction from transcript windows
Exports memories as markdown mirror files
Recall hook runner — budgeted inject at session start
Runtime config: embedding model, extraction model, recall budget, capture thresholds

key_folders.role: All capture-side modules: transcript reading, extraction, reflector, export, load-runner
Shared core: database, embeddings, recall, decay, consolidation, config, types, links
Express REST API and route handlers
Svelte 5 SPA dashboard — Memories, Review, Sessions, Search, Tasks, Agents, Skills views
CLI commands: index, search, inspect, backfill
Knowledge file scanner and parser — indexes agents, skills, plans, tasks, notes from ~/.claude/
Claude Code hook scripts and hooks.json manifest
Compiled JS output from tsc — what hooks and MCP server actually run

conventions: Flat codebase — minimal folders, minimal abstraction
SQLite boolean columns as INTEGER 0/1 (number type in TS)
Project slugs: lowercase, spaces → hyphens, Windows drive colon → double dash (e.g. C--Fran-project)
Default new atoms to load_at_init: false
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE must include all fields in SET clause
Smart project resolution: derive slug from cwd, fallback strategies
